stem: Per Rule 070101, how is staff development defined?

options.A: A one-time orientation given only to new recruits
options.B: A mandatory annual bonus scheme tied to length of service
options.C: The policy of enhancing staff knowledge, skills, attitude, effectiveness and efficiency to meet career goals and prepare for changing duties
options.D: A disciplinary process for underperforming officers

explanation: Rule 070101: staff development is the policy of enhancing knowledge, skills, attitude, effectiveness and efficiency to meet career goals and prepare for changing duties and responsibilities.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070103, training opportunities across MDAs are meant to be distributed in what manner?

options.A: Strictly in order of seniority, oldest officers first
options.B: Exclusively to officers within two years of retirement
options.C: Only to officers on Grade Level 15 and above
options.D: Equitably to all staff

explanation: Rule 070103: training opportunities shall be equitably distributed to all staff in MDAs.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070104, what defines a 'Course of Instruction within Nigeria'?

options.A: A course that can only be taken during annual leave
options.B: A course an officer undertakes locally but outside their own station, at a Federal Training Centre, University, or approved institution
options.C: A course undertaken strictly within the officer's own MDA building
options.D: Any course delivered entirely online, regardless of location

explanation: Rule 070104: a course of instruction within Nigeria is undertaken locally but outside the officer's station, at a Federal Training Centre, University or approved Public Service training institution.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070105, which training category is long-term postgraduate training considered crucial to both the officer and the MDA's mandate?

options.A: Category C
options.B: Category A
options.C: Category B
options.D: Category D

explanation: Rule 070105(a): Category A is long-term training toward a postgraduate degree that is very crucial and beneficial both to the officer and to the MDA's mandate.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070105, which training category is long-term postgraduate training that's beneficial to the officer but not crucial to the MDA's mandate?

options.A: Category E
options.B: Category B
options.C: Category A
options.D: Category C

explanation: Rule 070105(b): Category B is long-term training toward a postgraduate degree beneficial to the officer but not crucial to the MDA's mandate.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070105, which category covers officers pursuing a degree or qualification that might not even relate to their current schedule of duties?

options.A: Category F
options.B: Category C
options.C: Category D
options.D: Category A

explanation: Rule 070105(c): Category C is for officers who desire a degree or qualification in a field that might not be relevant to their current duties.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070105, what is 'Category D' training?

options.A: A mandatory annual refresher exam for all officers
options.B: Long-term overseas postgraduate study, fully government-funded
options.C: In-house training -- customized, cost-effective, short-term, delivered within or outside the office premises
options.D: Online courses leading to the award of a full degree

explanation: Rule 070105(d): Category D is in-house training -- a customized, cost-effective, short-term training/programme delivered within or outside the office premises.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070105, what is 'Category F' training?

options.A: Short-term online courses not leading to any qualification
options.B: Online courses leading to the award of degrees at accredited institutions
options.C: Overseas study exclusively for Directors and Permanent Secretaries
options.D: In-house training delivered on the office premises only

explanation: Rule 070105(f): Category F is online courses leading to the award of degrees in accredited institutions.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070201, what is a course of instruction 'on station'?

options.A: A course undertaken locally within the officer's own station, at accredited centers or the MDA's own training hubs
options.B: A course that requires relocation to a different MDA
options.C: Any course taken entirely outside Nigeria
options.D: A course delivered exclusively by video call from home

explanation: Rule 070201: on-station course of instruction is undertaken locally within the officer's station, at accredited centers, approved locations, Management Development Institutions, or the MDA's training hubs.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070203, who must furnish an officer with detailed instructions and advance written notice of allowances before an overseas course or duty?

options.A: The National Planning Commission
options.B: The host country's own government
options.C: The officer's Permanent Secretary/Head of Extra-Ministerial Office
options.D: The Federal Civil Service Commission, directly

explanation: Rule 070203: the Permanent Secretary/Head of Extra-Ministerial Office must furnish detailed instructions and inform the officer in advance and in writing of eligible allowances and travel facilities.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070205, an officer attending a course of instruction must sign a bond to refund government expenses if they fail to do which of the following?

options.A: Publish a research paper based on the course
options.B: Achieve a specific minimum grade on the course
options.C: Return to Nigeria after the course
options.D: Complete the course within exactly one calendar year

explanation: Rule 070205(b): the bond covers failing to return to Nigeria, among other conditions (obtaining a certificate of attendance, not taking further unapproved courses, and not resigning within three years).
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070205, within how many years of completing a course of instruction must an officer avoid resigning, to remain compliant with their bond?

options.A: Ten years
options.B: Five years
options.C: One year
options.D: Three years

explanation: Rule 070205(d): the bond requires not resigning from Service within a period of three years of completing the course.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070206, a senior officer sent overseas on a course of instruction is eligible for free air passage for whom?

options.A: Their entire immediate family, regardless of course duration
options.B: Themselves and their spouse, regardless of course duration
options.C: No one -- passage must always be self-funded
options.D: Themselves only

explanation: Rule 070206: a senior officer is eligible for free air passage for himself only; the spouse may accompany at government expense only where the course lasts nine months or more.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070206, for a course lasting nine months or more, who else may accompany a senior officer overseas at government expense?

options.A: No one -- the nine-month threshold only affects the officer's own return ticket
options.B: Both the spouse and all dependent children
options.C: Their spouse
options.D: Any one dependent child, but not the spouse

explanation: Rule 070206: where the course duration is not less than nine months, the officer's spouse may accompany him at Government expense.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070208, when a donor agency/country sponsors a course, what is the officer entitled to if the donor's allowance is lower than the standard estacode allowance?

options.A: The difference between their normal estacode allowance and the donor's lower allowance/facilities
options.B: Nothing extra -- the donor's rate applies in full regardless
options.C: A one-time cash bonus unrelated to the estacode difference
options.D: Double the standard estacode allowance, as compensation

explanation: Rule 070208: officers are entitled to be paid the difference between their normal estacode allowance and the donor's allowance/facilities, where the latter is lower.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070209, what happens to an officer's Federal Government emoluments if they receive a salary from an overseas employer during a training course?

options.A: Nothing changes -- both salaries are paid in full automatically
options.B: They must immediately resign from the Federal Public Service
options.C: Their Federal Government salary is automatically doubled
options.D: They become ineligible for Federal Government emolument or allowance, unless specifically approved otherwise by the Permanent Secretary, Career Management Office

explanation: Rule 070209: an officer receiving an overseas salary during training is not eligible for Federal Government emolument or allowance, except as specifically approved by the Permanent Secretary, Career Management Office (OHCSF).
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070210, what specific circumstance requires a female officer on a training course of not more than six months to refund some or all of its cost if interrupted?

options.A: Transfer to a different Ministry mid-course
options.B: Pregnancy
options.C: A family emergency of any kind
options.D: Any personal illness, regardless of cause

explanation: Rule 070210: a female Officer on a course of not more than six months' duration enters an agreement to refund the whole or part of the cost if the course is interrupted on grounds of pregnancy.
verification_note: Independently verified against the real transcribed PSR source text by two separate reviewers with no shared context (one automated subagent, one direct cross-check against the source transcript); answer confirmed.

stem: Per Rule 070301, where are nomination application forms sent for processing when training facilities require a foreign government's technical assistance scheme?

options.A: The Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation
options.B: The National Planning Commission
options.C: The Career Management Office
options.D: The Federal Civil Service Commission

explanation: Rule 070301: application forms for nominations of candidates under a foreign Government's technical assistance scheme are forwarded to the National Planning Commission for processing.

stem: Per Rule 070302, what happens to an officer's emoluments while attending a course under a technical assistance scheme?

options.A: Their emoluments are halved for the duration of the course
options.B: Their emoluments are paid by the donor government exclusively
options.C: Their emoluments are suspended for the full duration of the course
options.D: They continue to receive their emoluments

explanation: Rule 070302: officers attending courses under a technical assistance scheme will continue to receive their emoluments.

stem: Per Rule 070303, who decides the special conditions (such as leave without pay) when an officer takes a course purely at their own request?

options.A: The Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation
options.B: The officer themselves, subject to no approval
options.C: The National Planning Commission
options.D: The donor agency funding the course

explanation: Rule 070303: special conditions, which may include leave without pay and withdrawal of allowances, are decided by the Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation.

stem: Per Rule 070304, what is the maximum period of study leave with pay that may be granted for a postgraduate course not offered by any institution in Nigeria?

options.A: Four years
options.B: Six years
options.C: One year
options.D: Two years

explanation: Rule 070304: officers may be granted study leave with pay subject to a maximum of four years, in exceptional cases where the course is not offered by any Nigerian institution.

stem: Per Rule 070304, are officers pursuing private studies for a higher degree on their own initiative hindered from doing so?

options.A: No, provided their studies do not interfere with official duties
options.B: No, but only if they are already on Grade Level 15 or above
options.C: Yes, unless they first resign from the Federal Public Service
options.D: Yes, private study for a higher degree is prohibited entirely

explanation: Rule 070304: officers engaged in private studies for higher degrees shall not be hindered, provided their studies do not interfere with official duties.
